title: 2022 Select Blue #99 Khalil Mack Buffalo Bulls Football Card

descriptionText:
This Khalil Mack 2022 Select Draft Pick Football card features the talented player in his Buffalo Bulls uniform. The card is made of premium quality card stock with a thickness of 20 Pt. It is an original card from the Select manufacturer's base set and features a blue parallel/variety. 

The card is perfect for fans of the National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) league, and especially those who followed the NCAA Championship event/tournament in 2022. The card is in excellent state and ready to be added to your collection. Make sure to grab this unique sports trading card today!
